## What changes for the user?

## Evidence

include positive and confusing negative examples, required capabilities, and
remaining uncertainty. Keep authored tests distinct from independent evaluation.

## Catalog impact

State whether accepted observations or rankings would change. Engine changes do
not publish a new official corpus; the owner performs that release separately.
Do not attach personal results or raw downloaded chart data.
